subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` also block supervised Gateway `update.run` managed-service handoffs, or stay limited to configured background auto-updates?
rationale: The code boundary is clear, but changing the env variable would broaden an existing operator contract from automatic applies to explicit control-plane update requests.

options.title: Extend the existing kill-switch
options.body: Block supervised `update.run` managed-service handoffs when `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` is present, and document that incident-recovery mode disables both background and Gateway-originated package update restarts.

options.title: Keep the kill-switch scoped to auto-update
options.body: Leave explicit `update.run` behavior unchanged, clarify the docs, and route launchd update reliability through the canonical macOS update.run handoff issue.

options.title: Add a separate explicit-update guard
options.body: Introduce a distinct operator-controlled block for Gateway `update.run`, accepting the added config/env surface after maintainer approval.

recommendation.title: Extend the existing kill-switch
recommendation.body: Block supervised `update.run` managed-service handoffs when `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` is present, and document that incident-recovery mode disables both background and Gateway-originated package update restarts.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced the current env kill-switch and has recent repository-member context on the related macOS update.run handoff contract.
